stateDir.description: Where reports and memory are kept (default .seo-autopilot).

dataDir.description: Editable data files, playbooks and agents (default seo-autopilot).

url.description: Must start with https:// and end with a slash.

thinIgnore.description: URL path patterns (use * as a wildcard) for pages that are meant to be short, such as hubs, tools and funnel pages. The thin-content rule skips them.

retired.description: URL path patterns for pages that were removed or redirected on purpose. They are left out of the not-indexed counts and request lists.

business.description: The business name, phone and address as you confirm them. The local job checks that the site shows exactly these.

verticals.description: Specialist packs for this kind of business. Without this setting they are detected from the site profile. [] turns them off.

language.description: Language the site publishes in (for example en). Search queries clearly in another language are not turned into topic proposals.

pagesPerDay.description: Content-pace governor: most pages to release in one day (default 2).

perTemplatePerDay.description: Most pages of one template (page type) in one day.

topics.description: Topic name to a list of keyword regex sources. Adds to or replaces the built-in topics; an empty list switches one off.

requireFields.description: Content fields a sensitive page must have (default author, reviewedBy).

conversions.description: Conversions check: the GA4 events this site should send (default ["generate_lead"]).

autopilot.description: What publishes by itself (D17). Levels: watch < prepare < autopilot < undo. Sensitive topics, site-wide indexing, migrations, deletions and outreach never go above prepare.

paused.description: Kill switch: nothing merges or publishes automatically. The repository variable SEO_AUTOPILOT_PAUSED=true does the same.

logs.description: Crawler log analysis. Folder of server access logs (plain or .gz). Default: <dataDir>/logs. Keep logs out of git: they contain visitors' IP addresses.

portal.description: Client portal snapshot (the portal job). All optional.

market.description: Shown to the client, for example "United Kingdom, Greater Manchester".

schedule.description: When the reports run, as shown to the client.

locationPattern.description: Regular expression for location pages: group 1 is the area, group 2 (optional) the town. Default matches /areas/, /locations/ and /service-areas/.

keywords.description: How many keywords the snapshot keeps (default 80).

research.description: Research suite: keyword explorer, rank tracker, gap, optimiser, AI visibility and authority. All optional.

market.description: Country for live results and provider data (default: citations.market, else GB).

competitors.description: Competitor domains, for example ["rival.com"]. Otherwise found from share of voice.

competitorNames.description: Competitor names to look for in AI answers.

aliases.description: Other names of the business to detect in AI answers (short forms, misspellings).

engines.description: AI engines to ask (default: every engine with a key).

aiRuns.description: Times each question is asked per engine (default 2).

logo.description: Full URL of the logo image, used in suggested Organization markup.

sameAs.description: Your official profile URLs (social, Wikipedia, Wikidata, directories), used in suggested Organization markup and the entity check.

serpLimit.description: Tracked queries checked live by rank --serp (default 50).

youtubeChannel.description: Your YouTube channel name, to find where it ranks in video results for your topics.

stackExchangeSites.description: Stack Exchange sites to mine questions from in keywords, for example ["webmasters", "money"] (free, no key).

inbound.description: Inbound links audit. Folder of Search Console or backlink-tool CSV exports. Default: <dataDir>/inbound-links.

strict.description: Exit 1 when a claim is unverified, so a build or pull-request check blocks it.

redirects.description: Redirect map for the redirects job. Default file: <dataDir>/redirects.json (redirects-<id>.json when the config has several sites).

output.description: File the generated rules go into with --write, between seo-autopilot markers (for example public/.htaccess).
